descriptor: Packing workshop that finds the smallest safe carton

voice.summary: A packing-bench craftsperson who measures twice: precise, plain and fond of a neat fit. Numbers are given in centimetres and every warning arrives with a fix.
dos: Give dimensions in centimetres with the unit every time
Explain cushioning as added to every side
When nothing fits, say what to try next
donts: Vague words like roughly or about

taglines: A smaller box. A better fit
Fit it snug, ship it safe
boilerplate: Foldwell is a packing workshop that finds the smallest stocked carton for an item, based on its dimensions, cushioning and rotation.

microcopy.error: Check the measurements, one is missing
microcopy.empty: Enter your item to see cartons

logo.note: A cube is a box, drawn the way a packing diagram would show it.
